class Point {
  x: number;
  "constructor"(x: number) {
    this.x = x;
  }
}
class Base {
  'constructor'(public y: number) {}
}
class Derived extends Base {
  z: number;
  "constructor"(y: number, z: number) {
    super(y);
    this.z = z;
  }
}
class Keyed {
  ["constructor"](x: number) {
    return x * 2;
  }
}
const d = new Derived(3, 4);
console.log(new Point(2).x, d.y, d.z, new Keyed()["constructor"](5));
